subject: Add a note to conf about the dangers of modifying dir at runtime (#887)
reason: The change touches only valkey.conf comments (a note about modifying 'dir' at runtime) and adds a TCL test that starting the server with --dir given twice works. No source code changes: no command, reply, config handling, persistence or replication behaviour differs between the change and its parent, so there is no path for a scenario to reach.
